Press **▶ Turn**, or drag the orange dot. Watch the name change. 按 **▶ 旋转**，或者拖动橙色的点，看看角的名字怎么变。

```{=html}
<iframe src="embeds/turning-angle.html" title="Turn an angle" style="display:block; width:100%; height:600px; border:1px solid #d6dee8; border-radius:12px; background:#fff"></iframe>
```

- **° Degrees 度数** shows how big the angle is. A right angle is 90°.
- **◠ Protractor 量角器** puts a protractor on the angle. Read the blue numbers: they start at 0 on the side that stays still.
- **🕒 Clock 钟面** shows the angle between the hour hand and the minute hand.

[Open it full screen](embeds/turning-angle.html){target="_blank"}
